text:
Alex: Heads up — PR #15892 is blocked by CI failing on Windows snapshots. https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/15892 :thinking_face:

Maria: Saw that. failing test is `integration/windows_smoke` snapshot mismatch. Seems flaky, only on shard-3.

Jon: Can someone trigger a targeted rerun for shard-3? I don't have perms to rerun specific jobs.

ci-bot: Buildkite: Job group rerun available — run `bk rerun --build 4589 --jobs shard-3` or click https://buildkite.com/redwood-ci/builds/4589

Alex: here's the failing snippet:
```diff
- expected: "Connected"
+ actual: "Conn..."
```
looks like a transient timeout; I think rerun should pass.

Sasha: I can rerun. Doing targeted rerun now.

Sasha: rerun started :rocket:

Jon: pinging @Maria for snapshot approval if the rerun shows snapshot drift.

ci-bot: Rerun complete — shard-3 passed, overall build still failing on `snapshot/kitchen-diff`.

Maria: ok new failure is in snapshot update stage. If rerun passes but snapshot changed because of whitespace, we should update with `yarn test -u` and include changelog note.

Riya: who can approve the snapshot update? I think we need two approvals for PRs touching eng infra.

Alex: I can approve the snapshot update, but need a second reviewer. @Sasha can you take a quick look at the updated snapshot diff? It's tiny (timestamp).

Sasha: reviewed and looks fine. :white_check_mark: Approving now.

Maria: approved too. Go ahead and push updated snapshot commit and I'll merge after CI green.

Alex: pushed update: `git commit -am 'test: update windows snapshot for PR #15892'` and pushed branch. Thanks everyone!

ci-bot: New build triggered: https://buildkite.com/redwood-ci/builds/4592 — waiting for final green.

Sasha: If build flakes again, we should open a short postmortem and mark test as flaky in flaky-tests board.

Jon: noted. If it persists, I'll add a debug flag to the test to log more.
